name: mad-maps
description: Custom map creation and viewing app built on Mapbox, similar to Google My Maps.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@mad-maps/server & npm run dev --workspace=@mad-maps/client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mad-maps/shared && npm run build --workspace=@mad-maps/server && npm run build --workspace=@mad-maps/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@mad-maps/shared && npm run test --workspace=@mad-maps/server && npm run test --workspace=@mad-maps/client
